description:
Linux system metrics overview with Top 5 performance metrics to watch.
Need to add these to be able to visualize data storage trend:

GF_FEATURE_TOGGLES_ENABLE=regressionTransformation
GF_FEATURE_MANAGEMENT_ALLOW_EDITING=true

targets.query:
from(bucket: "linux")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "load5")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value","_time","host"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> top(n:5, columns: ["_value"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_value","_time","host"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")



//  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "processes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "procstat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "cpu_usage")
//  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "$host")
  |> last()
  |> group()
//  |> group(columns: [ "host"])
  |> top(n:5, columns: ["_value"])
  |> keep(columns: [ "_value","_time","process_name", "pid", "host"])
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "linux")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart)
//  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "$host")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "diskio")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.name == "vda")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "read_bytes" or r._field == "write_bytes")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: false)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> top(n:5, columns: ["_value"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_value","_time","name","host"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")
